title: Tooling: 5.35× faster production leech_minor via base-256 byte lanes with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, `scripts/experiments/affine_vector_screens.py:leech_minor` still built each binary row with the historical pairwise sparse-dot genexpr. Jerry Chen’s opt-in adapter `research/leech-minor-byte-lanes/` (incorporated [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/898)) already proved an exact base-256 byte-lane algorithm with identical receipts. This PR wires that equivalent check into the **production** source used by `scripts/audit_affine_vectors.py` / `make verify-certificates`.

Only the source pin for `scripts/experiments/affine_vector_screens.py` changes inside `certificates/affine-vector-screens.json`. Every matrix entry is still materialised; Golay inventory, norms, rational span witnesses, binary elimination, polynomial-code screens and the retained historical `2^-31` language are unchanged.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median wall time:

- **leech-only:** **5.579 → 1.043 seconds (5.35×)**
- **complete audit:** **9.465 → 4.213 seconds (2.25×)**

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every `leech_minor` receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise.

Package: `research/leech-minor-production/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/leech-minor-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/leech-minor-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/leech-minor-production
python3.12 -I -B research/leech-minor-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_LEECH_MINOR_PRODUCTION leech_cases=5 code_cases=4 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/leech-minor-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_LEECH_MINOR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Zero-row / corruption controls reject; `require` gates remain under `-O`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): Jerry Chen’s `research/leech-minor-byte-lanes/` / [#898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/898) (opt-in byte-lane adapter; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2194) (same production-promotion pattern on `verify_factor`). No competing open PR on production `leech_minor` at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the affine/vector screens and original checker. Jerry Chen authored the byte-lane algorithm. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
